hero.description: RealityForge is an advanced multi-agent engineering intelligence system. It explores, understands, simulates alternative implementations, evaluates risks, and safely builds software with gated approval.

about.title: Beyond Ordinary Code Assistants
about.description: Traditional coding assistants guess snippets in isolation. RealityForge functions as a high-altitude Project Intelligence System that traverses your complete dependency graph, benchmarks multiple candidate solutions in simulation, and guarantees absolute zero-touch safety in analysis mode.
about.step_discover_desc: Scan stack, entry points, configuration manifests, and directory topology.
about.step_understand_desc: Comprehend data flows, internal boundaries, and operational constraints.
about.step_analyze_desc: Identify technical debt, structural flaws, and dependency couplings.
about.step_simulate_desc: Generate candidate implementation paths and project future trade-offs.
about.step_evaluate_desc: Stress test security exposure, latency impact, and maintenance costs.
about.step_decide_desc: Reconcile agent disagreements and produce defensible architectural verdicts.
about.step_implement_desc: Execute approved changes in isolated branches with gated human authorization.
about.step_verify_desc: Execute real regression tests and perform automated diff audits.
about.step_learn_desc: Persist non-sensitive architectural decisions into project memory.

features.title: Engineered for Complete Software Systems
features.description: Engineered with strict separation of concerns, defensive security gates, and exhaustive simulation before a single line of code is committed.
features.f1_desc: Automatically infers frontend frameworks, backend engines, databases, and CI/CD pipelines without pre-configuration.
features.f2_desc: Evaluates 2 to 4 competing architectural paths before touching code, calculating performance, risk, and migration effort.
features.f3_desc: Mode A is strictly read-only with 0 file writes. Mode B requires mandatory explicit human authorization before writing.
features.f4_desc: Preserves architectural choices, rejected experiments, and technical debt in clean, persistent repository memory files.
features.f5_desc: Never overwrites user code, bypasses security boundaries, or forces blind commits without human confirmation.
features.f6_desc: Pairs automated unit and integration tests with static security audits and code reviewer sign-offs.

architecture.title: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Coordination
architecture.description: Four collaborative tiers orchestrate project analysis, algorithmic simulation, gated engineering, and arbitration.
architecture.diagram_caption: Interactive Agent Topology & Directed Intelligence Pipeline

agents_section.title: 14 Purpose-Built Specialized Agents
agents_section.description: Every agent possesses an explicit, non-overlapping mandate to eliminate hallucinations and produce verifiable engineering outcomes.
agents_section.agent_pa_desc: Discovers frameworks, directories, public APIs, and entry points without modifying files.
agents_section.agent_sa_desc: Identifies architectural patterns, bottlenecks, and constructs clean redesign plans.
agents_section.agent_da_desc: Parses manifests, builds dependency DAGs, and detects outdated or conflicting packages.
agents_section.agent_ci_desc: Audits structural weaknesses, anti-patterns, hotspots, and public interface boundaries.
agents_section.agent_ss_desc: Formulates competing approaches and estimates engineering cost, risk, and viability.
agents_section.agent_fi_desc: Forecasts maintainability hazards, scaling degradation, and 2-year maintenance overhead.
agents_section.agent_fp_desc: Anticipates race conditions, memory leaks, unhandled promises, and null dereferences.
agents_section.agent_ps_desc: Simulates CPU, memory consumption, throughput, and I/O overhead before code execution.
agents_section.agent_dev_desc: Constructs isolated Git branches to implement approved plans under strict human review.
agents_section.agent_test_desc: Synthesizes regression test suites and benchmarks pass/fail execution metrics.
agents_section.agent_sec_desc: Scans for known CVEs, injection flaws, hardcoded credentials, and unsafe calls.
agents_section.agent_pe_desc: Refines query execution plans, algorithmic complexity, and cache layer strategies.
agents_section.agent_cr_desc: Conducts rigorous human-aligned quality checks against plan specifications.
agents_section.agent_di_desc: Arbitrates inter-agent disputes, weighs trade-offs, and issues the final defensible recommendation.

workflows.title: Predictable, Repeatable Workflows
workflows.description: Workflows sequence agents deterministically, guaranteeing read-only guarantees during discovery and gated prompts during execution.

how_it_works.title: How RealityForge Operates
how_it_works.description: An uncompromising engineering pipeline designed to safeguard mission-critical repositories.
how_it_works.step1_desc: RealityForge inspects manifests, source trees, and configs without running background write commands.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Rather than jumping to the first solution, the simulation tier generates multiple implementation options.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Engineering Mode stops completely until you examine the generated Implementation Plan and click Approve.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Changes are vetted by the Testing Agent and Security Agent in isolated branches with full regression reporting.

safety.title: Dual-Mode Safety Guarantee
safety.description: Guaranteed protection against accidental data loss, unexpected breaking changes, and credential exposure.
safety.mode_a_p1: 0 files modified, created, or deleted in the target codebase.
safety.mode_a_p2: Inspects AST, configuration, and packages using read-only scanners.
safety.mode_a_p3: Simulation metrics are labeled as projections, not certified facts.
safety.mode_b_p1: Never modifies code without explicit user confirmation of the plan.
safety.mode_b_p2: Isolated Git branches ensure your main branch is never compromised.
safety.mode_b_p3: Zero secrets, credentials, or keys are ever written to memory files.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about RealityForge's architecture and capabilities.
faq.q1: How does RealityForge differ from copilot coding assistants?
faq.a1: Standard coding assistants generate local code snippets on the fly without understanding system-wide architecture. RealityForge is a multi-agent project intelligence system that simulates multiple architectural solutions, forecasts technical debt, audits dependencies, and enforces human approval gates before writing code.
faq.q2: Will RealityForge modify my existing software repository without my permission?
faq.a2: No. Under Mode A (Analysis Mode), the system is strictly read-only and will never touch your repository files. Under Mode B (Engineering Mode), the system halts and requires your explicit written authorization on the Implementation Plan before creating a new branch or modifying any file.
faq.q3: Which programming languages and stacks are supported?
faq.a3: RealityForge is stack-agnostic. It features universal project discovery that dynamically inspects React, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI), Go, Java (Spring, Maven), C/C++, Rust, PHP, SQL/NoSQL databases, and cloud infrastructures.
faq.q4: Are the scenario simulation outcomes guaranteed predictions?
faq.a4: No. RealityForge explicitly distinguishes between confirmed factual test results, code-based static analysis, and heuristic simulated estimations. Simulations provide calculated trade-off projections to help you make informed decisions.
faq.q5: Does RealityForge store my API keys or sensitive passwords in memory?
faq.a5: Never. The persistent project memory mechanism stores only non-sensitive architectural patterns, historical decisions, test summaries, and known technical constraints in clean JSON format.
